name: What is the real permit timeline for a commercial remodel in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How long does a commercial general contractor need to get permits approved in Los Angeles for a tenant improvement or interior remodel?
mainEntity.text: How long does a commercial general contractor need to get permits approved in Los Angeles for a tenant improvement or interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit timing is one of the biggest unknowns in commercial construction because it depends on the project type, building department review load, and how complete the submission is. In Los Angeles-area projects, a clean plan set for a straightforward tenant improvement can move relatively quickly, while projects involving occupancy changes, structural work, fire-life-safety review, accessibility upgrades, or multiple departments can stretch much longer. The best general contractor will build permit time into the schedule instead of promising a fast start. Ask whether the contractor has recent experience with the specific city, what plan check comments typically come back, and whether they can coordinate architect, engineer, and specialty consultants before submittal. The safest approach is to treat the permit phase as a separate milestone, not an afterthought. If the contractor cannot explain likely review steps, correction cycles, and inspection sequencing, schedule risk is high.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial permit timelines in Los Angeles vary widely based on scope, plan quality, and required corrections. Simple interior tenant improvements may move faster than projects needing fire, accessibility, structural, or change-of-use review. The most reliable expectation is that permitting can take weeks or months, and adding complete drawings and local code experience usually reduces delays.
